author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description: #AdamSavage meets artist and puppet maker @LauraMathewsArt, whose winged #puppets — including this Phoenix — are based on real-life biological bird mechanics. To say these birds and dragon are extraordinary is to undersell Laura’s work.
title: Adam Savage Stunned by This Bird Puppet's Mechanics!

author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam picks up his build of a T-Rex stop motion armature he started last year, which necessitates making hold-down clamps for his rotary table. Follow along as he mills six pieces of steel into identical clamps and then commences to make the next vertebrae linkage in his Phil Tippett-inspired dinosaur!
